guide-lad-yai.name: Lad Yai Old Town Walking Street
guide-lad-yai.label: Old Town Walk
guide-lad-yai.one_liner: Charming Sunday evening walking street along historic Sri Takua Pa Road with street food stalls, Baba heritage desserts, and local crafts.
guide-lad-yai.menu: Tao Kua, Ang Ku Kuih (Turtle Cakes), Crispy Buer Tod, Local snacks
guide-lad-yai.tip: Open Sundays only! Best visited around 17:00 for golden-hour photography.

guide-bang-deen.name: Bang Deen Michelin Roti & Biryani
guide-bang-deen.label: Breakfast / Michelin
guide-bang-deen.one_liner: Michelin Guide recognized breakfast spot famous for fragrant Thai-Muslim chicken biryani and freshly rolled roti with rich chicken massaman curry.
guide-bang-deen.menu: Chicken Biryani, Roti with Massaman Curry, Chicken Mataba, Teh Tarik
guide-bang-deen.tip: Pair crispy hot roti with rich massaman curry and hot milk tea.

guide-mee-talad-khwang.name: Mee Phang Nga (Talad Khwang)
guide-mee-talad-khwang.label: Hokkien Noodles
guide-mee-talad-khwang.one_liner: Legendary handmade yellow Hokkien egg noodles tossed in fragrant shallot oil, served with giant crispy pork cracklings and dumplings.
guide-mee-talad-khwang.menu: Handmade Hokkien Noodles, Dry Tom Yum Wonton Noodles, Crispy Cracklings
guide-mee-talad-khwang.tip: Order dry Tom Yum egg noodles with extra crispy pork cracklings.

guide-moo-satay-kruaew.name: Kru Aew Satay & Khanom Jeen
guide-moo-satay-kruaew.label: Satay & Rice Noodles
guide-moo-satay-kruaew.one_liner: Beloved hidden gem in Thung Phra Pho serving charcoal-grilled tender pork satay alongside fiery southern Thai curry rice noodles.
guide-moo-satay-kruaew.menu: Charcoal Pork Satay, Southern Crab Curry Noodles, Peanut Sauce
guide-moo-satay-kruaew.tip: Charcoal grilled to order. Order satay skewers with peanut sauce and curry noodles.

guide-pa-da-hokkien.name: Pa Da Hokkien Fried Noodles
guide-pa-da-hokkien.label: Stir-fried Hokkien
guide-pa-da-hokkien.one_liner: Authentic wok-fried Hokkien noodles with seafood, pork slices, and runny poached egg in the heart of the old town.
guide-pa-da-hokkien.menu: Wok-fried Hokkien Noodles with Egg, Misua Soup with Prawns
guide-pa-da-hokkien.tip: Break the runny egg yolk and mix into the piping-hot wok noodles.

guide-pu-dam.name: Pu Dam Restaurant (Bang Nai Si)
guide-pu-dam.label: Local Seafood & Crab
guide-pu-dam.one_liner: Scenic riverside local seafood restaurant in Bang Nai Si known for exceptionally fresh mangrove mud crabs and fiery southern curries.
guide-pu-dam.menu: Steamed Mud Crab with Roe, Sour Crab Curry, Crab Fried Rice
guide-pu-dam.tip: Steamed mud crabs with spicy seafood dip are a must-try.

guide-jae-ouan.name: Jae Ouan Fresh Seafood (Nam Khem)
guide-jae-ouan.label: Coastal Seafood
guide-jae-ouan.one_liner: Top-rated coastal seafood eatery in Ban Nam Khem, serving wild-caught giant tiger prawns, blue swimming crabs, and authentic lime seafood sauce.
guide-jae-ouan.menu: Grilled Tiger Prawns, Seafood Tom Yum, Steamed Blue Crab, Wing Shells
guide-jae-ouan.tip: Ideal for dinner after visiting Ban Nam Khem Memorial.

guide-kae-padthai.name: Kae Pad Thai (Old Market)
guide-kae-padthai.label: Evening Pad Thai
guide-kae-padthai.one_liner: Popular evening street stall serving classic tamarind-glazed Pad Thai noodles with fresh prawns and crispy golden omelette wrapping.
guide-kae-padthai.menu: Fresh Prawn Pad Thai, Egg-wrapped Pad Thai, Crispy Fried Mussels
guide-kae-padthai.tip: Egg-wrapped Pad Thai with fresh lime and banana blossom.

guide-baan-lapp.name: BAAN LAPP (Homey Dining & Steaks)
guide-baan-lapp.label: Craft Dining & Steaks
guide-baan-lapp.one_liner: Cozy hidden gem dining room in Takua Pa serving homemade pork chops, creamy pastas, salmon with seafood sauce, and artisan desserts.
guide-baan-lapp.menu: Homemade Pork Chop Steak, Seafood Pasta, Salmon with Thai Dressing
guide-baan-lapp.tip: Warm romantic lighting after 17:30, perfect for evening dinners.

guide-iron-bridge.name: Bun Sung Iron Bridge
guide-iron-bridge.label: Historic Landmark
guide-iron-bridge.one_liner: Historic iron bridge constructed from retired tin-mining dredger steel frames, spanning across the tranquil Takua Pa River.
guide-iron-bridge.menu: River viewpoint, Tin-dredge steel photo spot, Sunset breeze
guide-iron-bridge.tip: Sunset golden hour from 17:00-18:30 illuminates the iron arches beautifully.

guide-old-town-street.name: Sri Takua Pa Heritage Street & Murals
guide-old-town-street.label: Sino-Portuguese Heritage
guide-old-town-street.one_liner: Preserved century-old Sino-Portuguese shophouse street with covered arcades and expressive street art murals depicting tin-mining heritage.
guide-old-town-street.menu: Sino-Portuguese Architecture, Five-Foot Way Arcades, Street Murals
guide-old-town-street.tip: Stroll along the covered arcades and explore interconnecting alleys.

guide-tam-nang.name: Tam Nang Waterfall (Si Phang Nga NP)
guide-tam-nang.label: Rainforest Waterfall
guide-tam-nang.one_liner: Magnificent 63-meter jungle waterfall nestled in Si Phang Nga National Park rainforest, with crystal-clear pools full of native brook carp.
guide-tam-nang.menu: 63m High Waterfall, Crystal Pools, Brook Carp Fish, Nature Trail
guide-tam-nang.tip: 10:00-14:00 offers the clearest sunlight reflection over the water.

guide-tuangrat-taosor.name: Tuangrat 100-Year Taosor Pastry
guide-tuangrat-taosor.label: Local Souvenir
guide-tuangrat-taosor.one_liner: The #1 signature souvenir of Takua Pa — crispy thin flaky pastries stuffed with savory salted mung bean and salted egg yolk, baked daily.
guide-tuangrat-taosor.menu: Savory Salted Egg Taosor, Sweet Bean Taosor, Traditional Pastries
guide-tuangrat-taosor.tip: Salted egg savory bean is the top seller. Delicious with hot coffee or tea.
